_comment: PUBLIC verification registry — the neutral trust anchor. Maps each measured build to its open-source commit + reproducible-build recipe, and lists the endpoints that should be running it. The verification service live-checks each endpoint's attestation against this. This MUST be run independently of any relay operator (an operator who controls the verifier can fake it).

sha256:efb093c03437be3491c52aed8a4229eee.name: fidrouter data plane (RA-TLS, distroless, reproducible, sealed BYOK, metering)

endpoints.name: claude-official
endpoints.notes: RA-TLS: TLS terminates inside the enclave and its public key is bound into the attestation, so verify the binding (the SDK does) rather than a CA — the per-boot certificate is self-signed by design.
